plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's love and values. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Two people can care deeply for each other and still leave the most important things unsaid. The affection is there, but without expression, it can be missed, doubted, or forgotten in the noise of everyday life.
advice: You strengthen this connection by saying what you appreciate. Thank them when it matters. Encourage them when they need it. Let them know when their presence, ideas, or efforts make a difference.
summaryShort: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
